meetings.headline: APDC approved converting a barn at 936 Mass Ave into living space, no binding review required
meetings.summary: The Architectural Preservation District Commission approved a siding change at the Jones House and approved a determination of applicability for a barn-to-living-space conversion at 936 Mass Avenue after resolving that the initial submission was incomplete. The commission also discussed a shrinking town budget allocation, directing available year-end funds toward the hometown heroes banner program and mailer supplies, and heard updates on the Brooks House, a municipal building reuse project, a demolition-delay violation, a possible APDC/historical commission merger, and a dysfunctional master plan steering committee.

budget_items.what_was_said: The homeowner said switching from cedar to Hardy plank siding saves him a significant amount and avoids painting. A commissioner noted it's roughly a $10,000 difference between the two options.

The chair said he had believed the $5,000 committee budget from last year would recur, but the town instead placed only a placeholder amount for next year. He noted the commission has not spent much of the original allocation.
Members were unsure whether the current fiscal year's $5,000 could still be used or moved before the fiscal year closes in about 20 days. The chair said he would find out.
Richard said the historical commission has roughly 2850 set aside before the fiscal year ends, to be confirmed, for use toward the hometown heroes banner program.
Members discussed directing available APDC funds to the hometown heroes banner program, conditional on the town accountant confirming current fiscal year funds remain available.
A member proposed pre-purchasing envelopes and stamps for next year's mailers with any remaining year-end funds, capping spending around $50 to $100.
The historical commission voted to use its budget for historical markers and is selecting historically significant sites, including the old buttonwood tree.

decisions.decision: The committee agreed the Jones House siding replacement should be classified as maintenance, not requiring a separate Determination of Applicability form (though a motion was still made for the record).
The review clock for 936 Mass Avenue had not started because the drawings submitted through the town's permitting portal were incomplete (no site plan, exterior finish, or use information).
With complete information provided at the meeting, the review clock for 936 Mass Avenue was considered stopped/complete.
The proposed new garage at 936 Mass Ave falls primarily under the building commissioner, and possibly the zoning board of appeals or planning board, with APDC serving only in an advisory capacity.

Adam Costa will ask the town manager how a resident's letter opposing the APDC/historical commission merger affects the timeline, before the group meets again ahead of a targeted November special town meeting.
The commission agreed it needs to press the select board/committee for a concrete proposal on selling or leasing the Brooks House before drafting a warrant article for town meeting.
